title: access.revoked data (v1)
description: CloudEvents `data` payload for `com.governauthzer.access.revoked`. Means: REMOVE this grant — deprovision the user from the role on the target application. Emitted whatever the cause (manual revoke, expiry, termination cascade, orphan cascade) — the connector action is identical. This schema describes the `data` member only. Additive fields may appear in future without a version bump, so consumers MUST ignore unknown properties.

access_id.description: The governauthzer access (grant) being revoked. A correlation handle; by the time this event is built the access row is already destroyed, so the payload is rebuilt from the live user/role/application.

id.description: Immutable governauthzer user id. Match against the user->target-account mapping you keyed at grant time.

email.description: Conventional cross-system match key. Mutable — prefer `id`.

application.description: The target system the role belongs to.

reason.description: Optional machine-readable cause of the revocation (e.g. `grant_expired`). Present when the revoke carried one; absent otherwise. Informational — the connector action (remove the grant) does not depend on it.
